decision.task_table: Own immutable domain rows and typed batched selection only.
decision.state_command: Own manager callbacks, selected row ids, fixed command and error tensors, metrics, and debug dispatch.
decision.payload: Bind selected rows, resolve domain frames, emit simulator reset writes, and update per-environment task facts.
decision.curriculum: Own sampling probabilities, rolling outcomes, and per-row success rates.
decision.motion_provider: Own read-only reset, reference, expert-edge, and evaluation views over one immutable robot-motion bank.
decision.algorithm_bridge: Map named environment facts, final observations, evidence, and motion metadata to the RSL-RL transition contract.

state_command_result.construction: Build table, build payload against table, then allocate manager-owned fixed tensors.
state_command_result.selection: Keep one fixed-size long tensor of selected table rows; external curricula may write it in place.
state_command_result.resample: Optionally sample row ids, then call payload.bind(env_ids, selected_rows).
state_command_result.statistics: Read payload task facts for metrics only; no curriculum history or learner state lives on the command.

migration_units.name: shared_command
migration_units.proof: The shell has no TensorDict, reset writer, coordinate branch, learner cache, reward-provider branch, or success-history storage.

migration_units.name: position_domain
migration_units.proof: Payload.bind reproduces the current selected spawn write, target construction, env-origin framing, masks, timers, and command/error tensors elementwise.

migration_units.name: factory_domain
migration_units.proof: Payload.bind reproduces the current paired-row reset, held-asset goal, symmetry reduction, thresholds, hold duration, and command/error tensors elementwise.

migration_units.name: curriculum_ownership
migration_units.proof: success_rate_sampler builds the layout once, allocates exactly layout.num_items rates, gives that tensor to SuccessMonitor and Sampler, and exposes it through CurriculumManager.get_term().

migration_units.name: learner_cache_decoupling
migration_units.proof: No shipped Position or Factory preset asks StateCommand to teleport all rows and materialize observations. Generic value-shift code, if retained, accepts an explicit external immutable cache and names no command method.

migration_units.name: superseded_motion_attempt
migration_units.proof: No algorithm-branded environment, last-frame goal command, per-clip task-row duplication, runtime HDF5 load, target-observation cache, or simulator-specific divergence patch remains.

required_new_tests: shared payload-bind lifecycle and reset-ownership regression
curriculum-owned success-rate allocation and stable-storage regression
StateCommand dependency and forbidden-symbol architecture test

systems_evidence.scope: Exact historical and final shell construction/resample/update with tensor-equivalent Position-like and Factory-like shapes.
absolute_final_path: initialization time and peak Python memory
randomized and externally-pinned resample throughput and Torch allocation operators
owned tensor storage and pointer stability

gates: A regression proves StateCommand delegates binding and reset ownership to the payload.
The regression fails when the payload bind call is removed.
Position selected-row reset, target, command, error, success, and timer tensors match the frozen behavior.
Factory selected-row reset, target, command, error, success, and timer tensors match the frozen behavior.
Curriculum rates have one owner and retain stable storage while selected row ids are updated in place.
No command-owned observation cache or algorithm-branded motion command remains.
Initialization time, hot resample time, allocations, and peak memory do not regress materially.
All known Position and Factory tests pass, followed by repository pre-commit.
